summary:
Lens: unjust INCORRECT, coverage loss, crash and time. I wrote 923 cases, each run as verify() on both copies (0e93ed5 and wip/son-kalkulus = 4e2e4d7), so 1846 runs, plus about 40 timing and mechanism scripts. Groups: point derivatives with Abs/Piecewise/cbrt/trig; at(diff) evaluation; f'(x)=0 and f'(x)>0; tangents; limits; extremum; domain_of and inequality set notation (R − {2}, \setminus, \cup); textbook pieces (logs, trig equations, percent, complex numbers, a limit as a function argument); derivative functions and antiderivatives; integer parameters; Piecewise boundary, point-branch and equal-branch variants. Cases, scripts and results are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-asd/f97a07bd-dea8-5bbe-88dc-ada419b43e01/scratchpad/son_denetim/son-kalkulus/ret-kapsama/ (vakalar.py, kos.py, kar.py, out_base.jsonl, out_dal.jsonl). The copies were deleted.

Result counts (base→branch): CORRECT→CORRECT 555, UNKNOWN→UNKNOWN 199, UNKNOWN→CORRECT 101, INCORRECT→INCORRECT 34, UNKNOWN→INCORRECT 17, CORRECT→UNKNOWN 10, INCORRECT→UNKNOWN 4, INCORRECT→CORRECT 3. No exceptions in either copy.
- All 17 new INCORRECTs are mathematically right: Piecewise corners and jumps, R − {−2}, R − (2, 3), and so on. The two exceptions are the product-rule forms (x∛x)' = ∛x + x/(3∛x²) and the variant with ∛(x²), which are undefined at 0 where f'(0) = 0 exists. That follows decision RK-8 (DECISIONS: 'x²eˣ(2/x+1) INCORRECT'). It is mathematically defensible, so I did not report it as a finding; the main session may want to know the natural product-rule output is now INCORRECT instead of UNKNOWN.
- Of the 10 CORRECT→UNKNOWN changes, 8 are fixes of false accepts. Two items on right answers are real losses (RK-COV-1).
- The fixer's checks hold. RK-9 side effect: acos(cos x)'(−1) = −1, asin(sin x)'(2) = −1 and (4) = −1 are CORRECT, and the opposite sign is INCORRECT; this is analytically right. The x|x| node rule, the C¹ junction values, R − {2} / ℝ∖{2} / \mathbb{R}\setminus\{2\} / \cup / R − [2, 3], ℂ poles (31 complex controls: no losses) and YO-3 limit arguments (doit gave no AccumBounds in 18 SymPy checks) all hold. _real_root_rule at r = 1 (cbrt(x)³), r > 1 and g(p) = 0 is correct. The time of the new switch reading is normal apart from RK-TIME-1.

Branch-induced issues: RK-TIME-1, which is pre-existing but reached far more often now (|x²−4|-type f'(a) went from 0.1 s UNKNOWN to 19–48 s CORRECT), and RK-COV-1 (small, fail-closed).

Serious pre-existing faults I found in passing:
- RK-EXT-1: max |sin x| on [0, π] = 1 is INCORRECT, while pi/10 for |sin x| + x/10 is CORRECT. The candidate list and the completeness check come from different solvers.
- RK-PW-EQ: for a Piecewise with a point branch, f'(p) is read as 0. The right value is INCORRECT and 0 is CORRECT, also in f'(x) = 0. This falls inside the scope of SON-G3-YO-1's decision; the branch classifies existence correctly but the value at() reads is still SymPy's 0.

Other pre-existing items, not reported as findings:
- ∫∛x = (3/4)x∛x and siblings are INCORRECT in both copies; this is G2RK-1, the integral branch's.
- MC option 'Yoktur' given with claim kind 'value' is INCORRECT through mc.consistency; this is an extraction-format issue.

Beş bulgu var, en ağırı ortak bir kökten geliyor. SymPy, kendi nokta dalı (Eq(x,p) ya da Ne biçimi) olan bir Piecewise'ı türevlerken p'de o dalın sabitini türevliyor ve 0 veriyor. Dal p'de türevin VAR olduğunu artık doğru söylüyor ama değeri bu yanlış formülden okuyor.

Bulgu çıkmayan alanlar (dalda yanlış onay yok):
- Köşe ve sıçrama (14 fonksiyon × 5), çok değişkenli Contains(v−p, ORIGIN), ikinci türev (C¹ birleşim).

- RK-9: acos(cos x)'(−1) = −1 CORRECT, 1 INCORRECT ve asin(sin x)'(2) = −1 matematikçe doğru (mpmath 50 basamak, iki yan −1).

Her bulgunun doğru cevabı mpmath ile 50 basamakta tek yanlı fark oranlarından bağımsız hesaplandı. Düzelticinin 'kayıt' maddeleri (U5, xˣ ailesi, RK-5/6/7/10, evaluate köşesinde UNKNOWN) bulgu yapılmadı.
